feature_policy.uncertainty: Synchronous reference-object bootstrap for group zeros and color coefficient. Colors treated fixed; no production adoption without color-error qualification and independent validation.

n3_pilot.scope: Position-identified stationary spectra; identical frozen r detections replayed before reference comparison. All-filter trial is provisional native-error/SNR/fatal-flag qualified, not adoption or blind completeness. Faint Gaia proper motions never read. Native plane error approximation unchanged.

n3_year.scope: Whole held year excluded from every target band before association. Frozen r-anchor additions and independent no-NSC-r anchor route separated; non-r r magnitudes come from actual SDSS r and are labelled. All bands eligible by physical quality; object IDs never enter training association. One-to-one 1arcsec held matches and four displaced-position controls. Conditional residuals are not absolute dark-star PM truth.
n3_year.limitations: Candidate counts only, not adopted reliable stars. Unknown identities/blends are not successes; native W0 shared-night errors are uncalibrated. Footprints of qualified exposures do not prove a faint target had sufficient SNR. Original object-index r acquisition selection remains. No adopted full catalogue until independent source/error/zero validation.

n3_members.scope: Post-fit stationary spectral positions identify source and individual training members; PM similarity never labels identity. Unknown members and nonspectral sources are not declared correct. Neighbor/deblend indicates suspicion, not image-level blend truth. Zero known errors in finite samples retains Wilson intervals. No source selection or fitting changed.
n3_members.uncertainty_scope: Spectral-zero intervals resample objects only. Shared physical groups require separate uncertainty/zero certification; their common error cannot be averaged down by source count.

north_one_00_00.scope: Same frozen objects and exact r/all detection identities, original native W0 weights and four parameters. Reference groups and a single DECam-g color coefficient were trained only on original galaxy training references. QSO never train coefficients. Scores are conditional on fixed source colors; color measurement uncertainty and its effect on coefficient attenuation remain unqualified. No production adoption from this trial.

b_16_00.coefficient_precision_note: A/D are actual float32 FITS 5E coefficients. Their half-ULP gives a possible constant great-circle-coordinate roundoff, not a target centroid error. Recentered residual is a diagnostic, not a new astrometric correction.
b_16_00.scope: Position-only reconstruction from published row/column, optical-distortion/DCR and affine coefficients; compares exact published per-band angular offsets. No proper-motion truth, no extra astrometric correction. Scalar r errors are not cloned.
b_16_00.native_error_scope: Centroid covariance assumes independent native row/column errors and fixed color; field MUERR/NUERR treated as great-circle coordinate errors in arcsec. Published r error ratios test the convention. Cross-band shared scan/calibration covariance and color-error propagation remain unverified.
b_16_00.adoption: Not approved for joint fitting yet: centroid/WCS covariance, shared-scan errors, per-band detection flags and independent held-object validation still required.
